description: This file defines data structures, enums, and types related to System Information Block (SIB) configurations and cell reselection parameters for 5G NR (New Radio) networks, as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331 and TS 38.304. It includes structures for different SIB types, scheduling info, and cell reselection criteria.

methods.name: get_sib_info_type
methods.description: Determines the type of a given SIB variant (sib2_info, sib3_info, etc.) and returns the corresponding sib_type enum.
